detail: After an applied live limit change the owner serves POST and control under the default header limits (64 256 16384), not the store's sealed profile limits: books/owner-served-bound.lisp fn-osb-config passes the bare natural (fn-sbud-payload-bound profile) to fn-inj-make-config-full, and a bare natural selects *fn-article-default-limits* (books/injection.lisp:447); fn-owner-apply-limit-profile -> fn-osb-install runs on the live-limit path (host/native/admin.lisp:1074) with no fn-owner-posting-configure after it; a restart repairs it. Measured: a store sealed at max-header-fields 10 refused a 12-field POST before `policy set max-transactions 14' and accepted it after (persvati, developer image of lane/spans int 9b03401cd; fn-osb-config is unchanged on dev 877786836). Retirement: lane spans-osb-limits (fn-osb-config passes fn-inj-post-bound of the profile's article octets and header limits; keystone fn-osb-install-serves-the-profile-header-limits; the native test is the subject row).
notes: closed by lane spans-osb-limits: fn-osb-config installs (fn-inj-post-bound A (fn-bs-profile-header-limits profile)); keystone fn-osb-install-serves-the-profile-header-limits; native test tests.test_native_header_limits...test_a_live_limit_change_keeps_the_sealed_header_limits
